claims.sourceText: The National Archives UFO files page, August 2011
claims.text: August 2011 tranche note: 'Seven files in this tranche (DEFE 31/182/1-188/1) contain copies of numerous UFO reports made by members of the public and submitted to MoD between April 1993 and July 1996. These reports are duplicates of papers from tranche #4 of the UFO files, released by The National Archives in August 2009.'
